mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained residential construction activity that supports consumer wealth and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals robust manufacturing output that increases corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals persistent price pressures that may trigger aggressive central bank tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a declining unemployment rate signals strong labor market conditions that enhance consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances during low unemployment regime when UNRATE declines, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals economic contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
